name: Hanakyuu
source:
The main character is Toshiaki Uemura, a typical university student living alone in the big city. The story begins in Christmas night, when Toshiaki and his girlfriend Sumomo fulfill physically their love for the first time. Their future seems now firmly set, but the next morning, while Toshiaki and Sumomo are on the way to their university (in Japan, Christmas is not a holiday), an unknown woman, Mayumi, approaches Toshiaki with an unusual request: "Do you want to care for this flower seed?"

[Edited from a forum post by Baldo]
translation:
主人公植村俊明是一名独自生活在大城市里的普通大学生。故事始于圣诞夜，俊明与女友李第一次用身体确认彼此的爱。二人的未来似乎已经确定，可第二天早晨，俊明与李前往大学途中（在日本，圣诞节并非法定假日），一名叫真由美的陌生女子突然接近俊明，提出一个奇怪请求：“你愿意照顾这颗花种吗？”

[编辑自Baldo的一篇论坛帖子]
